steps.name: The Temple of Seres Reclamation Army
steps.objective: You can reach the "Temple of Seres" through "Vanaheim"!\nFind [Aileen] at the "Reclamation Army Temporary Camp".

steps.name: Um, About That Letter of Recommendation…
steps.objective: Talk to [Aileen], then travel to the "Guild Union" and report to [Einst].

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Halt! You cannot enter without an entry permit!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have one...

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: We can't let just anyone in. You still need to register with the reclamation force. You don't look like an enemy, but we must verify your identity.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: If you have a recommendation or a document proving you're a member of the temple, please show it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. Isn't there some way?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for someone. I heard she left Riveria for the Temple of Seres. Her name is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: We have much to do. We don't have time for a long conversation with someone whose identity hasn't been verified.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Please bring a recommendation bearing the seal of someone we know by name and can trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone who can vouch for me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone you might know is so far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, do you know anyone in the Guild Union? What about Einst?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Einst? Yes. If you bring a recommendation from him, we'll accept it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Enrollment Complete
steps.objective: Talk to [Einst], then travel to the "Reclamation Army Temporary Camp" and report to [Aileen].

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (As soon as Einst hears %s's story, he looks puzzled.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I wondered what brought you back after so long. You need a recommendation to enter the Temple of Seres? Things are complicated there right now. Demons appeared and attacked the temple.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: So the Guild Union members with ties to the temple hurried there. First, I'd like to hear your story. Why did you go to the Temple of Seres?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain what has happened.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Really? The girl you've been searching for went to the temple to meet Lady Seres? Where did she suddenly appear from?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There hadn't been any news of her until now, had there? The temple is unexpected. As for meeting Seres, I wonder whether anyone can even meet the goddess of legend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know yet, so please write me a recommendation.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Of course. You need to get there first, so I'll write one.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Wait just a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: If you join them, it should give them an advantage...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not that skilled yet...

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Haven't you already resolved quite a few incidents?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Perhaps you'll find what you're looking for there. Don't lose confidence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: But to do that, you may also have to help the reclamation force.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: In such troubled times, there's no other way for someone arriving to look for a person to earn their trust.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Here. Take a look at this recommendation.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Einst finishes the letter, stamps it with his official seal, and hands it over.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Be sure to remember what I said earlier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, understood.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh, and as your reputation grows, there will be people who try to use you. I'm saying this because you're kindhearted and seem unable to refuse.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You understand what I mean, don't you?

steps.name: Terms of the Deal
steps.objective: Talk to [Aileen], then report to [Tigris] at the "Reclamation Army Temporary Camp".

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: You've brought Einst's recommendation.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Let me check it.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: (Aileen reads the recommendation intently, then looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Nothing is wrong. You've resolved a great many problems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes...

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: I'm a little surprised by how much you've accomplished. You came from another continent and helped the Guild Union... Your record is impressive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Things just turned out that way.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Hmm. Let me look it over once more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Einst wrote a lot in that recommendation...)

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: He says you'll be an enormous asset and asks us to trust you... An asset, hmm... I hadn't intended to give you a combat assignment, but I'll report to Tigris.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: It says you can survive among numerous enemies and complete your mission without difficulty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How long should I wait?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Oh, permission has just been granted. If you'll work with us, we'll give you our full support.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Welcome aboard. We look forward to seeing what you can do.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Our commander, Tigris, is in the center of the camp. Please go to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

steps.name: Pretus
steps.objective: Go to the "Temple of Seres Approach" and defeat [Imp Scouts] and [Blue Swamp Tribe Assault Troopers]. Then enter the "Temple of Seres Interior" and report to [Pretus].

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: (Tigris reads Einst's recommendation, then looks at %s's face again.)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: To think I'd see a recommendation from Einst. A man who rarely praises anyone, offering praise like this... Remarkable.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It seems you've been through a great deal. Has it been difficult?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened, but I'm all right now. Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's nothing. I heard you played a major role in the recent Dragon Emperor's Palace incident. What on earth happened there...?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: As far as I know, most of the enemies were the palace's regular army, which once ruled the land. Were they human? Or...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's difficult to explain...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's all right. You don't have to tell me everything.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Anyway, what is the main reason you came all this way? I don't see the desire for fame or riches in your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for a girl named Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain how my search for Iris brought me here.)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: I'm glad you came.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: I mean you haven't come to the wrong place.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Until recently, we were with Lady Iris, the one you're searching for. She knew you would come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: R-really?!

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Yes. Our temple's finest are protecting her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand protecting Iris, but why assign your elite troops to her? Other people at the temple must need protection too...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: She is the subject of a divine oracle. I'll leave it at that for now.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Now I'll trust your record and ask you to lend us your strength. For Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: A paladin named Pretus is inside the temple. Meet him first and hear about the enemies within.

steps.name: Clearing the Temple Interior
steps.objective: Defeat [Succubus Mages], [Butterfly Rider Scouts], and [Elite Satyr Fighters] in the "Temple of Seres Interior".

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, are you Pretus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tigris sent me.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Have you come to stop me? I cannot turn back. As the church's gatekeeper, I failed in my duty. I deserve to die.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Tell Tigris that, however much he values me, there is nothing he can do. Please return. This place is dangerous.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: This isn't a place just anyone should enter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, Tigris asked me to infiltrate the area inside...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He told me to ask you about the enemies there.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You mean the Dragon Newts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that what they are?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: So you came without knowing anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then could you tell me about the situation here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know the general circumstances, but I thought it would be best to hear from you.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Since the commander sent you, I'll explain. The temple was attacked by a demon force led by one of the demon realm's races, the Dragon Newts.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: A Dragon Newt named Blas is called their legion commander and directs the demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please continue.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: It seems they came here on the orders of Lux, who is known as a lord of the demon realm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You know that name. Then you must be... the one who resolved the incidents at the Dragon Emperor's Palace on Jiendia, and at Drulridge and Riveria here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What...? How did you...?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: The information reaching the temple included stories about you. And those incidents, of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux, lord of the demon realm, and the Agasura...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Anyway, let me explain the temple's situation.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Most of the demon troops that attacked have left, and only Blas's army remains. They seem to be searching for something.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Whatever it is, I cannot forgive these demons and their kind.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: So many people suffered unjustly. For their sake, I absolutely cannot retreat from here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pretus, do you have any idea what the demons are looking for?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I don't know that much.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I'm sorry I know so little...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something important left here?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: They took all the objects and records containing the goddess Seres's power.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Records of the goddess Seres should originally have remained on Jiendia, but at some point they came to be preserved on Freios as well.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Perhaps another god wished to spread the goddess's words.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: For now, we must clear out the demons here. If any remaining survivors were to encounter them...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I don't even want to imagine it. Please help me. This is also work done for our god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For a god... Ah, yes. I'll do what I can. I'll be going.

steps.name: Blas, 1st Legion Commander
steps.objective: Go to the "Sacred Hall", subdue [Blas], and talk to him.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: ...Incredible. You truly possess extraordinary skill. I'm sincerely impressed.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: It's selfish of me, but I'd almost like to ask you to keep working for the temple...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: That would be too much to ask, wouldn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I have something I need to do...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: It's all right to refuse. Shall we press a little farther now? I think you could face him.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Blas...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: We can't plan the temple's future until we defeat the one leading these demon troops. Please, adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks dangerous, but I'll try.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Yes. I knew that would be your answer. You should be able to face him.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Subdue Blas as soon as you find him, and find out why he came here.

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Heh... It's been so long since I was struck by such a powerful attack. And from a human, no less...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: I have lost. I admit defeat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some demons refuse to accept defeat and make every kind of cowardly excuse...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: I don't care...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: You look as though there's much you want to know from me, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Those eyes remind me of a boy from long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about, but I'd like you to answer me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you attack the temple? If you truly wanted to attack it, you could have done so before. Why now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what were you searching for when you stayed behind?

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: So many questions. There is nothing I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer me... Now... If you don't, I'll...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Heh. You're hesitating. How amusing. There's a stench all around you, adventurer. But this isn't merely the smell of blood from those you've defeated...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Kill me. Don't act like a hypocrite, as other humans do. Otherwise, I'll kill you right...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Damn it. I don't even have the strength left to kill you. For Lord Lux, I will simply die. I will not betray him!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does Lux mean to you that you'd go so far?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me what you know, and I'll consider what to do with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the information is useful, I might... W-wait...

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: (Blas grins, writhes in pain, and gradually fades away. He seems to have chosen to destroy himself rather than reveal information about Lux.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-what are you doing? Don't disappear!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to keep you alive somehow and get that information...

steps.name: Why They Seized the Temple of Seres
steps.objective: Subdue [Baphomet] in the "Sacred Hall", then find out why the Lux Legion is stationed at the temple.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: A demon choosing to destroy himself... I thought demons had no loyalty or sense of duty, but I was wrong.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do now? We still have so little information...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Wait a moment. Let me think of another approach.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Ah, I think another being is still inside the temple... A demon called Baphomet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baphomet? Why would he still be here?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: He's Blas's trusted subordinate. He may not have managed to escape yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if that demon chooses to destroy himself too?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I encountered him once. I don't think he will. He seemed reluctant to come here, so he'll surely look for a way to survive.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Demons instinctively recognize someone who has defeated a being stronger than themselves. He'll realize it as soon as you approach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then I'll go meet Baphomet and talk to him.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: ...I couldn't believe you'd defeated Blas... But it was true...

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: What on earth are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a human.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: I've seen very few humans with skills like these. What kind of human are you...?

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: Don't tell me... Who sent you?

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: Did Lux send you? Or another power from the demon realm...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, talk.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: And if I refuse?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you only came here reluctantly. Give us the answers we need and leave quietly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We don't want much from you.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: W-will you really let me live?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. If you tell me everything you know, I'll ask them to show mercy.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you attack the temple?

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: Power. Lord Lux needed a god's power. It's obvious: he wants this world in his hands. That's why he's searching for the power of this world's gods.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: He intends to seize everything connected to divine power. The Temple of Seres is a place where an especially large amount of it remains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Surely you know that Seres, the God of the Astral Realm, vanished long ago.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: I don't know much about that, but I heard a similar power was here.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: We intended to find the one who possessed that power and take them to Lord Lux. That would have completed our mission...

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: But in the end, we couldn't find them. I suppose the god had no intention of giving us power.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: That's all I know. Truly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A similar power being here would mean...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. You can go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And never show your face here again. Promise me that one thing. Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: (Before I can even finish speaking, Baphomet runs away without looking back.)

steps.name: Deal Complete?
steps.objective: Report to [Tigris] at the "Reclamation Army Temporary Camp".

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You're back. Did you learn anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: (Pretus looks surprised as he hears about the conversation with Baphomet.)

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I see. Perhaps the oracle... the oracle left by the goddess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now please tell me about that oracle.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I'm sorry. My rank doesn't permit me to discuss it. Please find Tigris and tell him what you've accomplished.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Then he'll tell you what you want to know. Thank you again. I'll continue clearing this place and searching for survivors.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Adventurer... Oh, already gone. You looked disappointed...

steps.name: The One Who Met Iris
steps.objective: Talk to Battle Lord [Leo] at the "Reclamation Army Temporary Camp".

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You dealt so swiftly with the enemies who gave us such trouble...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You really are as capable an adventurer as I've heard!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, please tell me. You have a promise to keep.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You seem somehow angry. As promised, I'll tell you why Lady Iris was here, and where she went after the temple attack...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Will I finally be able to meet Iris...?)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Lady Iris came here a year ago. After fighting the Demon King, she disappeared, then reappeared and came here through Riveria. She said Lady Seres had saved her and that she needed to meet her...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: We'd been waiting for Lady Iris to arrive. Just beforehand, we received an oracle telling us to protect her. I can't say which god sent it, but her arrival made us believe it.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: All this time, we've protected Lady Iris without informing members outside the temple. I'm sorry about that. It was such a momentous matter...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Lady Iris slept and did not wake for a long time. Then Lux's demon army suddenly attacked.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: We assigned our finest escorts to Lady Iris and sent her far away. What they wanted was clearly divine power...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Only then did we understand why the oracle had told us to protect her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux intended to use Lady Seres's power to rule the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then that power...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You're right. We weren't merely protecting a girl. We were protecting a goddess with a new destiny.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's as hard for me to believe while telling you as it must be for you to hear.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Lady Iris's timely arrival was probably Seres's guidance. While Iris slept, Seres seems to have given her the power residing in the temple.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: That is how Lady Iris, in a human body, was chosen as the god who would succeed Lady Seres.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Lady Iris is in great danger. Many seek her power. That's why we had to assign escorts and get her away from here.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's hard to believe, but Lady Iris told us that you experienced another world. Yggdrasil, she called it...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: For now, Lord Belosh seems to have resolved that problem temporarily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belosh? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: One of the three Demigods...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was that something a Demigod could resolve?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: He says he resolved it, so we have to trust him. He is an excellent Demigod of our temple.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: So don't doubt him. Trust him as someone who is helping Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something seems strange...)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Demigods pursue the light and destroy darkness with power received from the ancient gods. Everything else they accomplish through experience and effort.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You may not know this, but many places, including the temple, have suffered ominous attacks. We were able to hold out thanks to these Demigods.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: So we have to trust the one escorting and serving Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: If you're still doubtful, there's nothing I can do. Belosh is suspicious of you too.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Lady Iris asked him to wait so she could meet you, but he said there was no time and urged her to leave...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I was a little too late...

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's all right. It's all right. You'll meet Lady Iris when the time comes. She's looking forward to it too.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: She should be traveling with the Demigod to somewhere safe now. Ask Leo for the details.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Oh, already gone. I was going to thank you once more...

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Lady Iris? As Tigris said, she's with the Demigod... All right, all right. To be precise, she went to the eastern continent.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Why are you surprised?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The eastern continent? Where is that?

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: A special continent east of Freios. I heard she went to the great Sword God Ziskad there.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: While escorting Lady Iris, Frozen thought of it as a safe place. He said he had connections there from when he visited the East Land on business long ago.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Lord Ziskad gave his permission, so that's where they must have gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did they move there? Is it really safe to trust them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: All right, all right. I'd heard someone was coming to meet Lady Iris, just like the stories said. I never thought it would really happen.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Lady Iris is incomplete right now. Please understand that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Becoming a god in a human body cannot be easy. And now demons are attacking because of that power...

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: I'm sure she'll manage... but I don't know how long it will take her to become complete.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: So she needs many people's help right now.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: There will be no shortage of enemies targeting her...

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Will you still go to see Lady Iris? Someday, you may have to face all those enemies.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: I'd like an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right with that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So please tell me how to get to where Iris is.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: (Definitely not an ordinary person. Just as Lady Iris said...)

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Oh, sorry. My mind wandered for a moment.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: All right, good. Wait a little. Once everything is ready, I'll make sure you can get there.
